replacements.title: Historical API dependency-coverage erratum and required final recipe
replacements.after:
The first Round14 full API run failed one release-certification case (271 files;3156 passed,1 failed): its required list still named16 journeys while the current real-browser harness emitted17, including labour replay. The [coverage erratum](evidence/implementation-2026-09-12-round14/release-browser-journey-correction/contract.json) preserves checkpoint39 and the actual earlier Round13 API3050 pass, but does not credit that pass as final-source API proof for the later17-journey harness. The broader old manifest captured the browser dependency, while the required current-prefix comparison omitted it. The corrected requirement must reject old16-only evidence, and a fresh final API run must compare the complete source/fixture dependency set after it is frozen—including web/apps/web/test/, root and nested workflows, report/ratchet registers, release scripts and all other external files or absence observations read by the tests. Failed logs remain evidence; a broad capture alone cannot substitute for checking those dependencies against the tested snapshot.
